items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: We can get any of them. We get, let's call it H.

ctx.x: Well, any of them that we can get. We don't make no difference. We can get any of them. We get, let's call it H. Yes. Well, we mostly, well, see H's daddy was the president of the club at one time. Fred Minor. Well, then Fred resigned as president of the club. But he still was, we carried him as a passage member until he died. Well, then, to Fred we used to get eight.
